Levels:

Added more M1928s

Thank you all for your continued support!

notes.title: Friendly AI + Upgrades Menu
notes.content:
Upgrades Menu
It has come to my attention many of you are playing this game solo. To help you folks out, I've added a buy menu for upgrades (including friendly AI).
-I hope to further expand upon this menu as development progresses.
-On Dunkirk you will receive new credits each minute.
-Omaha currently has no buy menu options because the AI are misbehaving and they need a time out.

Note: There are NO MTX. All credits are in-game.


Friendly AI + Bug Fixes
Some *basic* AI companions have been added. You can purchase them through the buy menu. I intend on further improving the AI in the future as well as adding new types of companions.
There have also been various bug fixes and visual improvements (although, certainly many more are needed).


I am also working on a public Trello board to give you all a better sense of what to expect in the future.


EARLY BIRD DISCOUNT ENDING SOON 
Purchase now if you haven't already and enjoy the continuous free updates!



To all those who have supported the game thus far, from the bottom of my heart, thank you!

notes.title: Dev Log #3 DEMO THE 8TH
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

I know you've all been wondering about the launch info so here it is!


1. The official launch date is October 20th, 2020 at approximately 12:00 PM PDT.

2. There will be a launch discount of 10% off so grab this game quick!

3. A small demo will be launched during Steam Game Festival: Autumn Edition on October 8th. This free demo will feature Dunkirk which will give you a brief sample of what's to come. The full version will have more maps, more weapons and more danger for you and your friends to face!


As always thank you for your support and please continue to help spread the word!

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.content:
1. Most Recent Progress
The most recent* area of improvement was the Omaha map. The LCVP has been added and seems to be working (well… for the most part). The Bangalore Torpedo has also been added so you can *inhales* CLEAR THOSE SHINGLES. 


2. Team Size
The number one goal is to follow where the design leads you. Designing levels for the (more popular) smaller team size while also catering to the larger count has proved challenging. So, henceforth the Fireteam Mode will be the core option while Squad Mode will be experimental. 

Fireteam Mode (2-4 Players): The classic cooperative action you know and love. Whether it's just you and a buddy or a whole fireteam you'll be engaged in tough firefights that will require coordination and teamwork.

Squad Mode (5-8 Players): A more experimental mode involving a larger player count. Engage in larger scale combat that provides more firepower on your side but, an increased burden in coordination.



3. Release Date
As you may have guessed, the release date has been pushed back to (at least) fall. Wish I could give you a more specific date or time frame but, (as with most games) it's always tough to say. 


*Many other tasks have been completed this was just the most recent.

notes.title: Dev Log #1
notes.content:

We’ve also begun testing more and more to try and iron out issues ahead of time. The next area I hope to tackle is improving the networking performance. 


Thank you for your continued support! Please continue to spread the word!
